context: The party has just met Lord Enver Gortash and declined his offer of alliance. This is the first debrief after that meeting, and Karlach—who’s in the party—is tired, angry, and a bit hurt by the encounter (there was no combat). She asks the player what they thought of Gortash, and the player replies that he seemed “an absolute fraud in a very nice coat.” Off-screen, Gortash is a rising, politically powerful figure (the Grand Duke/ceremony context), so the meeting carries wider political consequences the party will have to navigate.
